g.text: R1: Standard IBM-PC 34-pin FDD rear interface; cable twist handled by firmware selection.

g.desc: R1: Standard IBM-PC 34-pin FDD rear interface; cable twist handled by firmware selection.

g.text: 5V inputs use 5.5V-tolerant LVC245 at 3.3V. Outputs are TN0702 open drain; ASSERT=1 pulls cable LOW.

g.desc: 5V inputs use 5.5V-tolerant LVC245 at 3.3V. Outputs are TN0702 open drain; ASSERT=1 pulls cable LOW.

g.text: J3 is the isolated seven-wire contact output. J5 series seat-NO/eject-NC loop MUST open before disk motion.

g.desc: J3 is the isolated seven-wire contact output. J5 series seat-NO/eject-NC loop MUST open before disk motion.

g.text: Pico is a factory-assembled SMD module plugged into TH sockets. Carrier assembly is through-hole.

g.desc: Pico is a factory-assembled SMD module plugged into TH sockets. Carrier assembly is through-hole.

g.text: Legacy floppy encoding/track streaming and native dock protocol require new firmware; no compatibility claim.

g.desc: Legacy floppy encoding/track streaming and native dock protocol require new firmware; no compatibility claim.
